CustomField.description: Formula: (Unit_Price - Min_Price) / Min_Price * 100. Negative = below floor price, requires escalated approval.
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Min_Price__c)), Min_Price__c > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Unit_Price__c))), ((Unit_Price__c - Min_Price__c) / Min_Price__c) * 100, NULL)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Percentage difference between requested Unit Price and Min Price. Negative means below floor. Calculated only when both Unit Price and Min Price are populated.
CustomField.label: Price Variance %
